dashboard.infoCard: This is the administration area of Space Agent. It is part of the framework firmware and is intentionally unmodifiable. This area can be used to fix problems when customware breaks or to help with customware development. Standard maintenance and enhancements can be done with standard Space Agent itself.
dashboard.notAdminWarningHtml: You are not a member of the _admin group, so you will only be able to modify your own directory and groups you are allowed to manage. _admin membership can be granted by other _admin members or through the CLI with node space group add _admin user <username>.

agent.composerHint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline
agent.customInstructionsNote: These instructions are appended at the end of the standard shared system prompt.
agent.maxTokensNote: Shared across both provider modes. Default 120000. When prompt history exceeds this, compaction runs automatically before the next send.
agent.promptBudgetNote: System, history, and transient rebalance to 100% of max tokens. Single history message is a percentage of the history budget.
agent.paramsNote: YAML format. Passed through to the active provider. Example: temperature:0.2

modules.title: Installed modules
modules.fileBrowserPlaceholder: Use the Files tab to browse module folders.

l2_self.label: L2 / mine
l2_self.description: Show modules installed in your own L2 directory.
l2_self.emptyDescription: Modules installed into your L2 directory will appear here.

l1.label: L1 / groups
l1.description: Show readable and writable modules installed in L1 group directories.
l1.emptyDescription: Modules installed into accessible L1 group directories will appear here.

l2_users.label: L2 / users
l2_users.description: Show aggregated L2 modules across user directories.
l2_users.emptyDescription: User L2 modules will appear here once they are installed.
